editionLabel: Action Phase Games English rules, eight-clan booklet
firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently visited a summer camp places a ninja first during setup; the last player to place a ninja takes the first game turn.
clarifications: Setup placement proceeds counterclockwise; game turns then proceed clockwise.
internalEvidence: Rendered PDF page 2 states both the summer-camp criterion for placement order and the last-placer rule for the first turn. Page 3 begins clockwise gameplay. This English booklet has eight Ninja Clan cards and twelve ninja meeples, matching the original Action Phase Games component set for inventory BGG 176565; later translated editions can differ.
